parsed.change_summary: The minimal change made to fix the reported vulnerability is to limit the number of characters printed from each field in the `printf` statement on line 47. This is done by using the `.*` format specifier with the size of each field minus one to prevent any potential buffer overflow or command injection.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger for the OS Command Injection vulnerability is blocked by limiting the number of characters printed from each field in the `printf` statement. By using the `.*` format specifier with the size of each field minus one (`sizeof(record.name) - 1`, `sizeof(record.surname) - 1`, `sizeof(record.city) - 1`), we ensure that no more characters than the allocated buffer size are printed. This prevents any potential buffer overflow or command injection that could be exploited by an attacker who controls the record fields.
